# DAW lessons

- The DAW lessons (`lessons/daw-*.qmd`, eight, in `_quarto.yml` after the Recording lessons; include `lessons/_daw-kit.qmd`):
  a small DAW, `apps/shared/daw/mini-daw.js` (`MiniDaw`; `<div class="mdaw" data-id data-preset data-show>`, documented at its top),
  playing the band's sounds (`BandSounds`) with its parts written by `BandMidi.generate` ("Session players"). Timeline, loop, click,
  step sequencer, piano roll, record from computer keys / MIDI, audio tracks from the mic (DAW 6: bleed, headphones, latency), quantize, clips, mixer, MIDI export, bounce to WAV, undo.
  Each lesson ends with an "In other DAWs" table (BandLab, Ableton Live, Logic Pro); DAW 8 (`daw-real.qmd`, no DAW on it) is a tabbed
  first-session checklist for each, every step linked to its manual page. Checked Oct 2026 against BandLab Help Center, Live 12 manual, Logic 12.3 guide. Test: `node tests/lessons/daw.cdp.js` (after rendering them).
- MIDI in: **Open MIDI** reads any .mid (`MiniDaw.fromMidi`: a track per file track + channel, channel 10 to kit pieces or congas, GM program to the nearest instrument; quarter-note time; the file's time signatures (meta 0x58) become the project's meter and meter changes, one mid-bar moves to the next bar line; first tempo only; at most 64 bars, 12 tracks; what was changed is said in the status). The Backing Track's Export MIDI → **Open in the DAW** leaves the file in localStorage `mdaw:handoff` and opens `lessons/daw-export.html`, where the first DAW with Files takes it (within 10 min; replaces the song, Undo brings it back). Test `node tests/lessons/daw-midi.test.js` (`NEG=1` must fail); the hand-off is in daw.cdp.js (render `tools/backing-track.qmd` too).
- Time signatures: project `ts` [n,d] + `tsMap` [{bar,ts}] (changes from a bar on; missing = 4/4), all bar maths in `MiniDaw.Meter` (mini-daw.js, "time signatures"): time stays in quarter notes, a bar is n*4/d beats, clicks fall on groups (quarters in x/4, dotted quarters in 6/8 9/8 12/8, 2+2+3 in 7/8, 3+2 in 5/8). Transport "Time ... from bar" menu (2/4 3/4 4/4 5/4 3/8 5/8 6/8 7/8 9/8 12/8), `data-ts="6/8"` starts a DAW in a meter. Ruler, loop, clip snap and lengths in bars, grid lines, position display, count-in (one bar), record length, MIDI export (0x58 per change) and import follow it; the band's Session players write in the meter at the playhead (its 5/8 and 7/8 are 5 or 7 beats squeezed to eighths). Tempo is quarter notes a minute in every meter; the preset drum / bass patterns stay 4/4 patterns; clips keep their beat place when the meter changes. Tests `node tests/lessons/daw-meter.test.js` (`NEG=1` must fail), meter block in `tests/lessons/daw.cdp.js` (`SITE=<dir> PORT=<n>` for a scratch render; its mic-recording check fails offline, as before).
- Session view (2026-11-10; `apps/shared/daw/session.js`, `data-show="session"`, lesson `lessons/daw-session.qmd` "DAW 4b", presets `lionloop` / `lion`): a pared-down Ableton Session View / Logic Live Loops on the same tracks and mixer. `p.scenes` + `track.slots` (slot clips loop; one a track; scene ▶ launches the row and an empty slot stops its track; launch waits for the next bar or beat; its own clock, stopped by playing the arrangement). Arrangement → Session: **Loop → scene** copies the loop bracket's notes into a new scene. Session → Arrangement: **● Record to Arrangement** logs launches from a bar line to a bar line and writes looped clips cut at the bar lines (replacing those tracks' clips in the span; turns the loop off). Chord roots: each scene row shows its roots (lowest note starting each bar of the bass slot) with their place in the key; clicking one cycles I-IV-V and moves every pitched clip in that bar by the same interval (parallel, right for major chords only); **Key** moves all pitched notes. Header of session.js has the model. The Lion Sleeps Tonight progression I-IV-I-V in F is as commonly taught, unchecked against the record; tempo and parts are ours. Not done: audio clips in the grid, dragging clips between slots, follow actions, a third (minor / ii, vi) chord choice, MIDI export of scenes. Facts about Live / Logic checked from search summaries only (sources in `scripts/sources/voice-daw-dj.py`). Test `node tests/lessons/daw-session.cdp.js` (render the lesson first; serves the samples from tests/band/lead/site/sf).
- Keyboard clip placement (2026-11-10; `Daw.prototype.arrKey` in mini-daw.js, table in daw-arrange.qmd): arrows move the playhead / track, [ ] pick clips, N new clip, P places the last-selected Session clip (P P P repeats), Shift+arrows move the clip, - = resize it, Alt = beats. Arrangement view only. Found while testing: the constructor's `this.key` (storage name) had been shadowing `Daw.prototype.key`, so NO DAW shortcut (Space, L, C, R, Q, undo) worked; the field is now `storeKey`.
- Volume automation, the foundation (2026-11-10; `data-show="automation"`, section "volume automation" in mini-daw.js; preview in daw-mixer.qmd): `track.auto = { vol: [{ t beats, v dB }] }`. The points ARE the level (the fader locks, "(A)" in the mixer); held before the first and after the last point, straight in dB between. Each strip has an `auto` gain node (input → auto → pan → fader): scheduled a step ahead in `schedule()` (reset on loop jumps), set to the playhead's level when stopped (`applyMix`), written offline in the bounce. Keys: V lane, A point at the playhead (at the level it already has), ↑↓ ±1 dB, ←→ ±1 beat (Shift 6 dB / a bar, Alt fine), [ ] points, Delete, Esc; mouse click / drag / double-click. Export: MIDI CC 7 per track (GM2 curve `dB = 40 log10(cc/127)`, so 127 = 0 dB is the ceiling and boosts above 0 dB export as 127; a change at most every sixteenth, so ramps are stepped ~2 dB on steep falls), read back by `fromMidi` (a constant CC 7 sets the fader; a varying one becomes points thinned to 0.5 dB). NOT verified: what Live and Logic do with CC 7 on import (search summaries could not confirm it; the lesson says to look). Only volume, only per track, absolute (not relative to the fader). Next steps if wanted: pan (CC 10) and other CCs as the same `auto.<name>` shape, a parameter list in the lane, clip-level (Live clip-envelope style) lanes, curves, copying points with clips. Tests `node tests/lessons/daw-automation.test.js` (`NEG=1` must fail), `tests/lessons/daw-automation.cdp.js`.
- Vim keys (2026-11-10): h j k l = ← ↓ ↑ → (H J K L = with Shift; read from `e.code`, so Alt works on a Mac), and a number before a key repeats it ("3k" = +3 dB on an automation point, "3l" three bars, "3p" three copies; `Daw.count` / `this.n` in `key()`; a lone 0 is not a count). Loop moved from L to **O**. Velocity vs. volume automation is explained in daw-mixer.qmd (this DAW's level = velocity^1.6 from `sounds.js`; piano / e-pianos also filter soft notes darker); a keyboard velocity flow is proposed there but NOT built. Microtonality (31-EDO): not built; the sampler already repitches fractional MIDI numbers, but the roll, keys, export and band are 12-TET (see the notes in the conversation / ask).
- Note mode, step 1 (2026-11-10; `edKey` / `vimModel` / `vimApply` in mini-daw.js, plan in `TODO.md`, test `tests/lessons/daw-notemode.cdp.js`): Enter on a selected clip, Esc leaves; motions h j k l w b e ( ) { } 0 $, objects iw ic ih ib ip iv, operators > < gU gu (doubled = this chord), r1-r8, counts (before the operator = how much, after = how far), `.`, u / Ctrl-r. A chord = notes sharing a start; a beat = a quarter note. Enter no longer means "back to the start" when a clip is selected (Home does). The band's session players' events all carry `vel` (checked 2026-11-10 across every style), but a chord's notes share one velocity and the patterns add random humanising, so two runs differ. Lesson `daw-notation.qmd` (DAW 3b, preset `ode`): the DAW vs written notation, what a computer must be told vs what performers infer.
- Feel (2026-11-10; `applyFeel`, `humanize`, the Feel menu and Humanize clip button in the Session players row; `data-feel="band|loose"` starts a DAW on it; tests `node tests/lessons/daw-feel.test.js` (`NEG=1` must fail), `tests/lessons/daw-feel.cdp.js`): writes the live band's human touches into clips (numbers read from `BandPlayer.FEEL`, i.e. `LAY` / `JITTER` / `STRUM` / `VEL_JITTER` in player.js): lay-back per part, triangle jitter, chord roll low to high (strums 28 ms, `strum` flag carried from the band's events), velocity wander. NOT tempo: the band's tempo is constant and so is the DAW's (no rubato anywhere). `clip.felt` marks a clip that has it (Humanize refuses twice; Quantize at 100% with no note selection clears the mark). The Backing Track's MIDI export does not add the touches either. Default stays Tight so the other lessons are unchanged.
- Scratch pad extras (2026-11-11; `tools/daw.qmd`, opt-in attributes `data-projects`, `data-clipboard`, `data-zoom`; lesson DAWs unchanged; header of mini-daw.js; test `node tests/lessons/daw-scratch.test.js` (`NEG=1` must fail), `tests/lessons/daw-scratch.cdp.js`): **Projects** = index `mdaw:<id>:projects` [{key,name,updated}], current `mdaw:<id>:current`, the old single `mdaw:<id>` migrates in as "Project 1" under its own key; New / Duplicate / Delete / rename / switch; undo cleared on switch; Save / Open project carry `name` (Open adds a project). Takes in IndexedDB are not deleted with a project. **Copy / cut / paste** (`Clipboard`, `copySel`, `paste`): selected notes (offsets from the earliest, pasted at the playhead in the open clip, clipped) else the selected clip (pasted on the selected track at the playhead's bar line, song grows to 64 bars); clipboard in memory and `mdaw:clipboard`. **Zoom**: `beatW()` = 26 px x `zoom.arr`; the lane's bar lines come from CSS `--mdaw-bar`; roll width / row height `zoom.rx` / `zoom.ry`; saved in `mdaw:<id>:zoom`; Ctrl/Cmd = / - (roll when focus is in it). Known old quirk: `duplicate` uses a 1e-9 bar test, so it can grow the song one bar too many (paste uses 1e-6).
- Track sound (2026-11-11; `apps/shared/daw/track-sound.js`, global `MiniDaw.TrackSound`, loaded by `lessons/_daw-kit.qmd` after session.js and inert without the attributes; scratch pad `tools/daw.qmd` turns on `data-organ data-fx data-synth` and loads `synth-kit.js` (`SK_NO_BAR`) before the kit; lesson DAWs unchanged; header of track-sound.js; tests `node tests/lessons/daw-scratch.test.js` (`NEG=1` must fail), `tests/lessons/daw-scratch.cdp.js`). A panel under the editor shows the selected track's sound. **Organ** (`track.organ` {bars, leslie, swell, click}): nine tonebar sliders + presets, Leslie slow / fast / stop, swell, key click; per TRACK through `bank.setDest(strip.input, ...)` in sounds.js (per-destination tonebars / Leslie / swell / click, `bank.prepare`, `bank.control(..., dest)`; the Backing Track never sets one). Lanes `track.auto.leslie` [{t, v: slow|fast|stop}] (steps) and `track.auto.swell` [{t, v 0..1}] (lines), added at the playhead from the panel (no drawn lane yet), scheduled in `schedule()` and written in the bounce; swell exports as MIDI CC 11 (NOT verified against any DAW or organ module; Leslie and tonebars are not exported). `track.auto` now may hold `vol`, `leslie`, `swell`; `autoDelete` drops `auto` only when all are empty. **Effects** (`track.fx` = 3 slots, each null or {kind, params, bypass, mix}; `track.sends` {reverb, delay}; `project.returns` {reverb, delay: {params, level}}): `makeStrip(ctx, dest, buses)` = input -> 3 insert slots (dry / wet) -> auto -> pan -> fader (-> meter -> master, and after the fader to the two buses, which return to the master); kinds eq compressor distortion amp chorus phaser delay reverb tremolo rotary filter, built by `SynthKit.fx` (see lessons/CLAUDE.md), the same on the OfflineAudioContext in the bounce; controls generated from `SynthKit.FX[kind].params`; effects are not in the MIDI export. **Synths** (`syn-sub` / `syn-fm` / `syn-wt` / `syn-chip`, listed only with `data-synth`; `track.synth` {params}): `SynthKit.voice`, one factory per strip (`TS.playSynth`, called from `playNote`), presets from the lessons, live keys / recording / schedule / bounce; stopped with the transport (`stopSound`); MIDI export GM programs 81 / 5 / 88 / 80 (our choice). Nothing here was listened to: levels, presets and the organ's tonebar presets are unchecked by ear. Not done: a drawn lane for Leslie / swell, effect automation, more than 3 inserts, per-note synth modulation, the wavetable scan LFO (the lesson widget has it), importing CC 11, sidechain / pitch / mic effects.
- Compose tools and nav (2026-11-11; scratch pad only, opt-in attributes `data-comp-menu data-abc-edit data-fill data-nav` on the `.mdaw` div in `tools/daw.qmd`; lesson DAWs unchanged; loaded by `lessons/_daw-kit.qmd` after track-sound.js; tests `node tests/lessons/daw-scratch.test.js` (`NEG=1` must fail), `tests/lessons/daw-scratch.cdp.js`). **Comping menus** (`Daw.prototype.compMenus`, `bandOver()`; `bandParts(..., over)` last arg): Comping piano/guitar, Rhythm (every `BandCatalog.comp` id, grouped), Voicing (`BandHarmony.styleList`); "Style default" = leave the style's own. **Edit as notation** (`abc-clip.js`, global `AbcClip`, pure: `clipToAbc`, `abcToNotes` via `AbcEvents.fromAbc`, `checkBars`, `noteSpans`, `merge`; panel in `compose-tools.js`): quantised to 1/16 (or 1/8), chords `[CEG]`, ties over bars, overlapping notes dealt into voices (`[V:1]` lines + `%%score (1 2)`), key menu (C, best fit, or any major), meter = the project's at the clip start (a meter change inside the clip is not written). Accidental memory is by letter (abc-core's rule). Apply = one undo step, velocity kept where pitch + quantised start match, others get the clip's mean; confirm first when notes are off the grid or a bar is the wrong length. abcjs gets `siteTitles:false` (the site's renderAbc wrapper otherwise prepends text and shifts `startChar`, which broke click-to-select). Round trip tested on random clips in 7 meters. **Fill from chords** (`Compose.plan`, `fillNotes`, `chordOf`, `chordsFromNotes`, pure): bars + chart cycled over them + source band style (`bandParts`, one part, band-row menus and Feel apply) / `MotifArp` type (`partNotes` is pure, no SeqPage needed; restarted at each chord, held notes = `BandHarmony.voicing` "standard") / Style Arranger section channel (`StyleEngine.convertPhrase` to each chord's `{root,type,bass}`; the section repeats over the bars; style meter must equal the bars) -> one clip on a new or chosen track (clips of that track in the range replaced), one undo step. "Chords from the selected clip" reads ABC chord symbols from the open notation panel, else `StyleEngine.recognize` per bar. **Nav** (`nav-tools.js`, `MiniDaw.Nav`): Step menu (1/16, beat, bar; localStorage `mdaw:<id>:step`); arrows = playhead a step (Shift a bar); Alt+arrows and h / l = selected notes, else selected clip, else playhead (H / L, Alt+Shift: a bar); Alt+up/down transpose notes (Shift octave); `,` `.` loop start / end at the playhead, `\` toggles loop, Shift+O (or "Loop clip") loops the clip, Esc deselects. These replace Shift+arrow clip moves only with data-nav (daw-session.cdp.js still uses them). `[ ]` stay "pick clip" (hence `,` `.` for the loop). Loop is in exact beats: `p.loop.fb / tb` (+ `from/to` bars around them), `Daw.loopSpan()` / `loopRange()`; `session.js` loopToScene uses `loopSpan`. Ruler (replaces the old bar-unit drag when data-nav): full-height loop region with two 14 px handles; drag across = new loop, edge = resize, middle = move, double-click a bar = loop it, click = playhead; all snapped to the Step; zoom-safe (beats x `beatW()`). Not verified by ear or by hand on a trackpad / touch; synthetic pointer events only. Fills and the arranger conversion are the site's own patterns; nobody has listened.
- Panels and position box (2026-11-11). **Panels** (`panels.js`, `MiniDaw.Panels`, `data-panels`, scratch pad only; needs `panel-columns.js` / `.css`, loaded by `_daw-kit.qmd`): each part (Projects, Transport, Session view, Arrangement, Editor, Track sound, Edit as notation, Fill from chords, Mixer, Session players, Files) is a `details.mdaw-panel` (id `<daw id>-pn-<name>`) in `.mdaw-colA`; `.mdaw-colB` is the sidebar, hidden while empty and shown while dragging; PanelColumns does grip / ⇄ / drag; layout `mdaw:<id>:panels`, folds `mdaw:<id>:panelopen`, "Reset layout" (PanelColumns reloads the page), Fold all / Unfold all. A panel whose part is `hidden` is hidden by CSS `:has`. All inside the DAW element, so ⛶ full screen keeps it (the cdp test only checks it where the browser allows full screen; headless said "nofs"). Automation, effects, sends and organ / synth live inside Arrangement / Mixer / Track sound, record and loop in Transport. The "Scratch pad" heading is gone from `tools/daw.qmd` ("How to use it" keeps the jump bar). **Position readout** (all DAWs, mini-daw.js `editPos`, `Meter.parsePos`): click it or press G, type `6`, `6.3` or `6.1.4`, Enter jumps, Esc / blur cancels, a bad entry shakes and says why; a beat is a meter group (a dotted quarter in 6/8), as `Meter.where` shows. Tests in daw-scratch.test.js / .cdp.js.
- Session / arrangement traffic and clip tools (2026-11-11; test `node tests/lessons/daw-session-tools.cdp.js`, render `tools/daw.qmd` first). **Session players → Session**: band row "Parts" (all / drums / congas / bass / chords only) and, with `data-show` session, "Write to" Arrangement | Session; Session puts each part in the first scene where that track has no slot (else a new scene, max 8), so Write again = another take to audition (`D.sessPutIn`, session.js; `bandWrite`). **Arrangement → Session**: "Clip → Session" button (`clipToSession`) and Ctrl/Cmd+V into the Session cell last clicked, empty ones too (`sessCur2`, `pasteToSession`'s `pasteToSlot`). **Loop → scene** makes each slot as long as the clips it came from (to a bar line), not the whole bracket (a 2-bar clip in a 4-bar bracket used to be 2 bars of notes + 2 of silence). **Loop corner**: top-right 13 px of an arrangement clip (`.mdaw-loopc`): click repeats once, drag repeats to the dragged bar, last copy cut (`loopClip`; real copies, clips starting in the span replaced). **J** joins the selected clip with the next on its track (3J = three more; `join`), **S** splits at the playhead (as the Notation tool's J / s); Join button next to Split. Shift+J no longer moves a clip down (Shift+↓ still does). Mixer: the master strip carries an invisible pan row and M/S row so its fader lines up. Not done: selecting several clips (the Notation tool's visual mode), M merge-with-previous, joining across tracks.
- Keys and sidebar, round 2 (2026-11-11; scratch pad only, `data-nav` / `data-panels`; tests in `tests/lessons/daw-scratch.cdp.js`). Plain h / l and arrows always move the playhead; **Alt (Option)** + h / l / arrows move the selected notes, else the selected clip. **Space** is play / pause even with the focus on a button, menu or slider (not in text boxes), and keys with the focus on the page body reach the first data-nav DAW (`nav-tools.js` document listener). **S** solos, **M** mutes the selected track (`msKey`; lowercase s still splits); SSS / MMM within 0.6 s turn every solo / mute off. **Tab** (`Compose.tab`, compose-tools.js): arrangement -> the active track's clip in the roll (the clip under the playhead, else its first) -> the ABC text with the selected note selected -> that note lit on the staff (`.mdaw-abc-cur`, via `getElementFromChar`) and selected in the roll -> the roll; Shift+Tab goes back. **Right-hand column**: Projects, Track sound, Edit as notation, Fill from chords, Session players and Files start in `.mdaw-colB` (`SIDE` in panels.js), shown beside the arrangement when the DAW is 1050 px or wider (a container query; full screen, wide windows), stacked below otherwise. A layout saved earlier keeps its old places until Reset layout. Not tried by hand.
